# Kyuhoshi

> > Travel guides and itineraries focused on Japan, featuring seasonal experiences and cultural destinations in Tokyo.

Kyuhoshi provides detailed travel planning resources for visitors to Japan, with emphasis on seasonal activities like cherry blossom viewing (hanami) and exploring Tokyo's neighborhoods, parks, and cultural landmarks.

## Key Topics

- Tokyo travel
- Cherry blossom (sakura) viewing
- Hanami season
- Spring travel in Japan
- Meguro River
- Shibuya and Shinjuku districts
- Tokyo parks (Yoyogi Park, Shinjuku Gyoen)
- Meiji Jingu Shrine
- 3-day itineraries
- Japan travel guides
- Seasonal tourism
- Tokyo accommodations
- JR train stations

## Tokyo Itineraries & Travel Guides

- [3 Days in Tokyo Spring Itinerary - Cherry Blossom](https://www.kyuhoshi.com/3-days-in-tokyo-spring-itinerary): Tokyo spring travel guide featuring cherry blossom viewing at Meguro River
